name: dltr_tabular_bench
description: A suite of tabular prediction tasks intended to evaluate models on structured (tabular) data across multiple datasets and problem types. Includes supervised classification and regression tasks with standardized splits and baseline metrics to compare model performance on tabular data.
evaluation_method: task-specific (accuracy / F1 for classification; RMSE / MAE for regression)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face-hosted collection for benchmarking tabular models; useful for practitioners but not a dominant community standard.
